item.title: Solved: How to Efficiently Split a DataFrame String Column into Two Columns
item.description: In the realm of data manipulation with Python’s pandas library, a common task arises when you find yourself working with a DataFrame containing a string column that needs to be split into two separate columns. For example, consider a DataFrame with a single column that includes both the FIPS code and the corresponding state name. Let’s delve deeply into several effective methods to achieve this, ensuring each method is equipped with practical code snippets.
